notices.body:
3935(P)/22 CHINA - East Coast - Traffic separation scheme. Separation zones. Precautionary areas. Restricted
areas.
Source: UKHO

notices.body:
Marine works - LNG Construction
Construction of the Woodfibre LNG facility is taking place in Howe Sound at 49 39.909N 123 15.114W.
Two floating worker accommodation to support facility construction and commissioning of the Woodfibre LNG facility are at 49 39.650N 123 15.480W.
A Marine Safety Zone has been established around the work site.
All vessels not affiliated with the project are to avoid the Marine Safety Zone.
Operations are active 24 hours a day. 
Vessels on site monitoring VHF channels 08 and 16.

notices.subject: [Navigational Warning] Repair work taking place daily, 24 hours a day at the Turcotte Bridge. Barge and tug on scene. Navigation channel reduced to 21.5 metre
notices.title: [Navigational Warning] Repair work taking place daily, 24 hours a day at the Turcotte Bridge. Barge and tug on scene. Navigation channel reduced to 21.5 metre
notices.body:
Marine Works - Bridge Repair
Repair work taking place daily, 24 hours a day at the Turcotte Bridge. Barge and tug on scene. Navigation channel reduced to 21.5 metres and is marked and lit. Air draft reduced to 12 metres.
Any vessels requiring the barge be moved to make passage under the bridge are required to give 72 hours notice by e-mailing m.poirier@pomerleau.ca or alexis.noel@pomerleau.ca, and provide them with:
Date and time of requested passage, vessel name and type, estimated speed of passage, length, beam, and draft of the vessel, and their contact information.
All vessels transiting the area are requested to remain 3 metres away from the barge.
Minimum wake requested.

POSITION 46-02.487N 073-07.082W

notices.id: Denmark. Kattegat. EK R 18 Jaegerspris. Firing exercises. Warning.
notices.noticeNumber: Denmark. Kattegat. EK R 18 Jaegerspris. Firing exercises. Warning.
notices.region: NAVAREA (NE Atlantic / UK / North Sea / Baltic)
notices.subject: [Navigational Warning] 27 October 2026, hours 09:00 - 15:00.
notices.title: [Navigational Warning] 27 October 2026, hours 09:00 - 15:00.
notices.body:
Denmark. Kattegat. EK R 18 Jaegerspris. Firing exercises. Warning.
27 October 2026, hours 09:00 - 15:00.
28 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 20:00.
29 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 21:00.
30 October 2026, hours 08:00 - 14:00.
In connection with firing practices in EK R 18 Jægerspris, a temporary prohibited area is established on the sea off the firing practice area in position:

- 55° 52'N - 011° 57'E.

During firing practices, all navigation, anchoring and fishing are prohibited in the area.
Information about firing practices is given by displaying the following signals from one hour before the start of the firing practice until its end:



a)
By daylight, a sphere is hoisted and a white, flashing light is lit (60 flashes per minute) on signal mast 1 and 3. 


b)
 30 minutes before sunset, lights displaying a red and white alternating flash (30 flashes per minute) are lit on signal masts 1 and 3.

notices.title: [Navigational Warning] BLACK SEA
notices.body:
BLACK SEA
BLACK SEA GRAIN INITIATIVE
JOINT COORDINATION CENTER (JCC) - ISTANBUL
182359Z MAR 23 UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE
DATUM WGS84.
THE BLACK SEA GRAIN INITIATIVE JCC HAS ESTABLISHED A ROUTE FOR VESSELS INBOUND AND OUTBOUND OF UKRAINAN PORTS. THE ROUTE IS 320NM LONG AND CONNECTS THE LISTED UKRAINIAN PORTS WITH INSPECTION AREAS INSIDE TURKISH TERRITORIAL SEAS.
THE MARITIME HUMANITARIAN CORRIDOR (MHC) FORMS PART OF THIS ROUTE AND EXTENDS FROM THE BOUNDARY OF UKRAINIAN TERRITORIAL SEAS TO THE SOUTHERN WAYPOINT OF THE HIGH SEAS TRANSIT CORRIDOR (HSTC).
WHILST TRANSITING THE MHC NO MILITARY SHIP, AIRCRAFT OR UAV MAY CLOSE WITHIN A RADIUS 10NM OF ANY VESSEL ENGAGED IN THE INITIATIVE AND TRANSITING THE CORRIDOR. VESSELS ENCOUNTERING PROVOCATIONS OR THREATS WHILE TRANSITING THE MHC SHOULD REPORT IMMEDIATELY TO THE JCC. NO VESSEL SHALL TRANSIT THE MHC WITHOUT THE AUTHORISATION OF THE JCC.
PILOTS WILL EMBARK FOR PASSAGE BETWEEN BERTH AND HOLDING AREA.

notices.body:
ON 27 OCTOBER 2026, AT 06.18 LOCAL TIME, THE PARTIALLY SUNKEN VESSEL M/V KHORYV WAS REPORTED IN POSITION
43-51.24 N 028-54.54 E
THE VESSEL IS STILL AFLOAT, IN AN UPSIDE-DOWN POSITION;
THREE CREW MEMBERS ARE REPORTED MISSING. ALL VESSELS IN THE VICINITY OF THE MENTIONED POSITION AND THOSE TRANSITING THE AREA ARE REQUESTED TO MAINTAIN A CONTINUOUS LOOKOUT;
IT IS RECOMMENDED TO MAINTAIN A SAFE DISTANCE OF AT LEAST 1 NAUTICAL MILE FROM THE VESSEL.
NAVIGATION HAZARD.
ANY RELEVANT INFORMATION IN THIS REGARD SHOULD BE TRANSMITTED TO MRCC CONSTANȚA ON VHF CHANNEL 16 OR BY E-MAIL TO MRCC@RNA.RO.

notices.noticeNumber: PERSIAN GULF - STRAIT OF HORMUZ - AND OM1218
notices.region: NAVAREA (Red Sea / Gulf of Aden / Persian Gulf)
notices.subject: [Navigational Warning] PERSIAN GULF
notices.title: [Navigational Warning] PERSIAN GULF
notices.body:
PERSIAN GULF
STRAIT OF HORMUZ
CHARTS BA 2837, 2851, 2858, 2888, 3172, 3174, OM1219
AND OM1218
SULTANATE OF OMAN HAS ISSUED FOLLOWING ADVISORY
1. THE SULTANATE OF OMAN BASED ON ITS RESPONSIBILITIES TOWARD THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ, AND ITS IMPORTANCE TO THE GLOBAL ECONOMY, AND IN ACCORDANCE TO ITS CONTINUED COMMITMENT TO THE INTERNATIONAL LAW AND THE LAW OF THE SEA TO ENSURE FREEDOM OF NAVIGATION IN THE STRAIT WITHOUT IMPOSING ANY TOLLS, IN LINE WITH THE OUTCOMES AND EFFORTS REACHED BY THE UNITED STATES AND ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN.
2. THE SULTANATE OF OMAN HAS WORKED IN COORDINATION WITH THE INTERNATIONAL MARITIME ORGANIZATION (IMO) TO PROVIDE
ALL VESSELS WITH THE OPTION OF A TEMPORARY MARITIME  CORRIDOR DEFINED BY THE COORDINATES LISTED BELOW.
3. THE SAFETY OF NAVIGATION REMAINS THE PARAMOUNT CONSIDERATION.GIVEN THE ELEVATED RISK OF COLLISION IN THE CURRENT ENVIRONMENT,
A GRADUAL AND CONTROLLED EVACUATION OF VESSEL TRAFFIC IS REQUIRED.

notices.subject: [Navigational Warning] UKMTO has received a verified time-late report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
notices.title: [Navigational Warning] UKMTO has received a verified time-late report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.
notices.body:
UKMTO has received a verified time-late report of an incident in the Strait of Hormuz.

A tanker transiting outbound was struck by an unknown projectile, disabling the vessel. The crew have been reported safe. There is no damage assessment or environmental impact report at present.

Vessels are advised to transit with caution and report any suspicious activity to UKMTO, whilst authorities investigate.

Position: 26-17.00N 056-33.00E

notices.subject: [Taiwan NTM] Taiwan Southeast Waters – Sunken Target Vessel
notices.title: Taiwan Southeast Waters – Sunken Target Vessel
notices.body:
本件屬公開資訊 
UNCLASSIFIED 
 
1 / 1 
 
海軍大氣海洋局航船布告 
 
中華民國115年10月19日 
181 臺灣東南部海域 － 靶船沉沒 
 
依    據 海軍115年9月18日電報。  
說    明 一艘靶船於115年9月18日1100時在下列位置沉沒，航行船隻請多加注意。  
位    置 北緯 22°22'27.6"，東經 121°35'48.6"  (W GS84) 
 
符    號 加註              
關係圖書 00051 - 0307 - 0313 - 0328C - 0343 
 
海軍大氣海洋局局長        
海軍上校   劉 得 凰          
 
 
NOTICE to MARINERS 
Published by Naval Meteorological & Oceanographic Office, R.O.C. 
 
Oct-19-2026 
181 Taiwan Southeast Waters – Sunken Target Vessel  
 
Source Navy, telegram dated September 18, 2026.  
Details A target vessel sank at the following position on September 18, 2026. Mariners are

SOURCE: MALAYSIA MARINE DEPARTMENT, PENINSULAR NTM 197(T)/2026.
AUTHORITY : DIRECTOR OF MARINE, MALAYSIA
POSITION : MALACCA STRAITS
CHARTS AFFECTED : MAL 532
BA 3946
SUBMARINE CABLE POST-LAY INSPECTION & BURIAL PHASE-2 (SEA-ME-WE6 )
MALACCA STRAIT
MARINERS ARE ADVISED THAT POST-LAY INSPECTION AND BURIAL (PLIB) WORK( PHASE-2) FOR
SOUTH EAST ASIA-MIDDLE-EAST-WESTERN EUROPE-6 (SEA-ME-WE 6) CABLE SYSTEM WILL BE
CARRIED OUT BY OPTIC MARINE SDN BHD. THE DETAILS ARE AS FOLLOWS:
DURATION : 14TH OCTOBER 2026 - 31ST DECEMBER 2026
VESSELS INVOLVE:
NAME IMO NO. TYPE
MICLYN ENTERPRISE 9474436 CABLE LAYER
WORK AREA:
REFER APPENDIX 1.
MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO NAVIGATE WITH CAUTION WHEN IN THE VICINITY AND KEEP CLEAR OF THE
WORKING AREA.
14TH OCTOBER 2026
